verdict.rationale: Bruno is documented as offline-only, with no cloud sync, no account and no plans to ever add cloud sync. Collections live as plain files on the user's filesystem, the desktop app runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, and official Docker images let the CLI run on the user's own infrastructure. Together this means the core product runs entirely on user-controlled machines with no vendor servers. Community comments corroborate the no-cloud appeal, but none explicitly report a hands-on self-hosted setup. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license or build-from-source instructions, and any self-hosted shared/team deployment option.
